Data integrity and interpretation. The original NIfTI voxel values are embedded unchanged and used as the spatial substrate. Pink/yellow activity, recurrent connections, wave propagation, and stimulation are generated by this demonstration model; they are not recorded neuronal signals, anatomical connectivity, or a clinical interpretation. The file contains a 46 × 55 × 46 float64 volume with 4 mm voxel spacing.
